messages.raw: §fI found an unexplored cave while mining for titanium. But it's too dark to see in there, even for me! Can you spare any glowing pumpkins?

messages.zh: 谢谢你! 新发现在等着我们呢。

messages.raw: §fWell then, I will even mine in total darkness if I must!

messages.zh: 那好吧,就算全黑我也照样挖!

messages.raw: §fI had a sunburn once, I have stayed down there ever since.
messages.text: I had a sunburn once, I have stayed down there ever since.
messages.zh: 我晒伤过一次,从那以后就一直待在下面了。
